The missing envelope has the greatest assigned slot number less than 7. A spare slot 8 is not assigned to a trail.
The witness saw the suspect waiting at the trail assigned to the selected slot, holding its envelope. Slots are not a riding order. Witness identification: Timing assistant.

puzzle.title: The Last Dispatch Slot
puzzle.description: Use the three written clues. Any numbered records, schedules, or diagram rules belong only to this fictional exercise.
puzzle.question: Which trail has the greatest assigned slot below 7?
hints: First remove unassigned slots and numbers that fail the bound.
Exclude the unassigned spare first, then compare only the assigned numbers below the bound.

Answer: Learners Permit. Among assigned slots 2, 4, and 6, the greatest number below 7 is 6. That slot belongs to Learners Permit. Slot 8 fails both the bound and assignment requirement. Warrant: Learners Permit; disguise: Timing assistant.
puzzle.explanation: Among assigned slots 2, 4, and 6, the greatest number below 7 is 6. That slot belongs to Learners Permit. Slot 8 fails both the bound and assignment requirement. The warrant location is Learners Permit; the witness identifies the Timing assistant disguise.

mtb-centennial.learningObjective: Select an extreme value subject to a strict bound and assignment rule.
mtb-centennial.accessibilityDescription: All evidence, rules, and choices are written text. No image, color distinction, map interaction, or prior local knowledge is needed.

reviewEvidence.notes: Chasing Rainbows: three Centennial trail names only; slot assignments invented.
